title: Non-Markovianity in the Adapted Caldeira-Leggett model
summary: In this work, we investigate the non-Markovian features of the Adapted Caldeira-Leggett model, a computationally efficient framework recently proposed to capture the essential physics of the standard Caldeira-Leggett model. While this effective model has been previously validated for decoherence and einselection, its ability to reproduce memory effects remains to be explored. By exploiting the model's capability to explicitly track both system and environment degrees of freedom, we provide a detailed characterization of non-Markovianity through the lens of information backflow.
